title: Trajectory of a Package
body: An airplane traveling horizontally at $$100$$ $$\frac{m}{s}$$ over flat ground at an elevation of $$4000$$ meters drops an emergency package. The trajectory of the package is given by $$x=100t, \quad$$ y=-4.9t**2+4000,\quad $$t\ge$$ $$0$$ , where the origin is the point on the ground directly beneath the plane at the moment of release.
